answer: A new worker is admitted only after a sealed door sensor is fitted at one registered address and reports for 30 consecutive nights, with 2,600 units held in escrow. Staff at a civic haven issue the sensor, photograph its serial against the door frame, and the unit blinks a nightly lantern challenge that cannot be replayed from a second doorway. An honest household spends one evening on install and parks 2,600 units. A 200-alias farm needs 200 distinct addresses and 520,000 units locked for a month, plus 200 certified installs; that voting-power delta exceeds short-term farming rewards.
